```renyi
public function count_words(text: Text) returns List of WordCount
  purpose: Count every lower-cased word, most frequent first.
  example: count_words("a b a")
    is [WordCount(word: "a", occurrences: 2), WordCount(word: "b", occurrences: 1)]
  example: count_words("") is []

  let words be text.to_lower().split(" ")
  let filtered_words be for each word in words where word is not "" collect word
  let grouped be for each word in filtered_words group by word count
```
```renyi
  let counts be for each word, occurrences in grouped collect WordCount(word: word, occurrences: occurrences)
  return counts.sorted by entry.occurrences descending
end
```

```renyi
public function count_words(text: Text) returns List of WordCount
  purpose: Count every lower-cased word, most frequent first.
  example: count_words("a b a")
    is [WordCount(word: "a", occurrences: 2), WordCount(word: "b", occurrences: 1)]
  example: count_words("") is []

  let words be text.to_lower().split(" ")
  let counts be
    for each word in words
    where word is not ""
    group by word sum 1
  let entries be
    for each word, occurrences in counts
    collect WordCount(word: word, occurrences: occurrences)
  return entries.sorted by entry.occurrences descending
end
```

```renyi
public function count_words(text: Text) returns List of WordCount
  purpose: Count every lower-cased word, most frequent first.
  example: count_words("a b a")
    is [WordCount(word: "a", occurrences: 2), WordCount(word: "b", occurrences: 1)]
  example: count_words("") is []

  let words be text.to_lower().split(" ")
  let filtered_words be
    for each word in words
    where word is not ""
    collect word
  let grouped be
    for each word in filtered_words
    group by word collect word
  let counts be
    for each word, occurrences in grouped
    collect WordCount(word: word, occurrences: occurrences.length)
  return counts.sorted by entry.occurrences descending
end
```
